structural_remaining.gap: Native source, compiler and dtype/error correspondence
structural_remaining.detail: Actual existing manually materialized typed source programs are executed. All original Python/compiler admission, unsupported profiles, errors/poison/sanitizers and noncanonical dtype families retain their prior obligations.

structural_remaining.gap: Native bytes, physical views and finite addresses
structural_remaining.detail: Whole tagged logical cells and Nat element offsets do not establish raw byte decoding, memory validity, mixed-width or shifted aliases, finite-width overflow or native allocation/layout.

Any complete permutation of whole programs is proved. Operations within each program remain sequential/atomic at this scheduling layer; native load/store interleaving, races and physical scheduling require separate refinement.

structural_remaining.gap: Remaining host, harness, module and dtype scope
structural_remaining.detail: The same135 existing integer/mixed logical profiles are refined. No new dtype pairs, original error branches, native host allocation/dispatch, harness or module execution are accepted.

inherited_numeric_obligations: Existing mixed-fp32 and mixed-small numerical/native bindings retain their exact scope. Total us/uu policies remain visible and defined-domain policy independence is unchanged.
proof_composition: Generic internal schedule lemma requires a real single-program success/memory theorem and same-offset locality. ValueSchedules supplies both using exact existing IntegerSource/MixedFP32/MixedSmall complete_correct and expected_cell theorems. No public specification assumes desired correctness or successful execution.
state_threading: Each whole program receives actual preceding memory and resets local registers/pid from the same initial context used by existing ascending grids.
alias_boundary: Equal logical region names are allowed because different program ids own disjoint element offsets. This does not imply physical mixed-width/shifted memory disjointness.
zero_N: The complete permutation of an empty grid is empty; only logical no-op behavior is proved.
source_views: Preserve all original source view records; these scheduling proofs do not establish an extraction or compiler bridge.
